output.description: Your draft output to validate. Either a JSON string (e.g. '{"a": 1}') that will be parsed with json.loads, or an already-structured JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, null).

schema.description: The JSON Schema (draft 7 or later) to validate 'output' against, e.g. {"type": "object", "required": ["name"], "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}}.

max_attempts.description: Optional informational hint: how many retry attempts you intend to allow yourself. Echoed back on FAIL; the tool does not enforce or count attempts itself.
